typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteName as string,
		RealtimeValueNumAverage as integer,
		MetricType as string,
		RecordModified as timestamp,
		RealtimeValueNumMax as integer,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetOperationalStatus as string,
		RecordModifiedBy as string,
		AssetName as string,
		RealtimeLastUpdated as timestamp,
		MetricName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		MetricUnits as string,
		RealtimeValueNum as integer,
		MaterialName as string,
		AssetID as integer,
		RealtimeValueNumMin as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		SiteName as string,
		RealtimeValueNumAverage as integer,
		MetricType as string,
		RecordModified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RealtimeValueNumMax as integer,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetOperationalStatus as string,
		RecordModifiedBy as string,
		AssetName as string,
		RealtimeLastUpdated as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MetricName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		MetricUnits as string,
		RealtimeValueNum as integer,
		MaterialName as string,
		AssetID as integer,
		RealtimeValueNumMin as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SiteName,
		RealtimeValueNumAverage,
		MetricType,
		RecordModified,
		RealtimeValueNumMax,
		AssetNumber,
		SiteGroup,
		AssetOperationalStatus,
		RecordModifiedBy,
		AssetName,
		RealtimeLastUpdated,
		MetricName,
		DataHall,
		MetricUnits,
		RealtimeValueNum,
		MaterialName,
		AssetID,
		RealtimeValueNumMin),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
